capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 82 kWh gross pack has 77 kWh usable (VW figure relayed by SlashGear 2023 first drive; Wikipedia table gives 82/77 for 2021-22 too). Same 82 kWh pack carried to MY2021 (cell supplier LG in 2021-22 vs SK On from 2023).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: thinkEV Canada 2026 ID.4 page lists NMC for the 82 kWh pack; same 82 kWh MEB pack on all model years (cell supplier changed LG to SK On in 2023; both assumed NMC, not stated by a page).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Guide Auto lists the 2025 Pro AWD 82 kWh pack at 400 V (MEB). Same pack all model years.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs says ID.4/ID.5 built 2020-2024 had no battery preconditioning (automatic only from 2024); software 3.9.1 (electrive: built before Oct 2023, needs 3.7+) adds only a manual button and no page says it reached US/Canadian cars; if it did, this car would be manual_only. Late-2023 builds may differ. European-sourced (InsideEVs/electrive name no market); a second look at VW US/Canada pages, US press and software-update coverage found no North American statement. Low confidence; owner to accept or verify.

dc_max_kw.notes: Launch cars were 125 kW (VW 2021 release); Green Car Reports: 2022 peak 135 kW versus the previous 125 kW via OTA update (Software 3.0); Wikipedia agrees. Recorded as the figure after the update; unupdated cars may still be 125 kW. MY2021 cars take the update over the air.

ac_max_kw.notes: 11 kW onboard charger (VW 2021 launch release relayed by ConceptCarz; SlashGear 2023: 11 kW on both packs; vw.com 2026 page: up to 11 kW home charging).
